text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer is the perfect opportunity for 
Umamusume to grow. That is why Tracen 
Academy holds a summer training camp every 
year to hone their abilities—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Duramente had also joined the training 
camp in preparation for the Kikuka-sho. 
Considering her physical condition, she 
couldn't train too intensely, but...
choice_data_list: Let's take our time and face it properly.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Right now, I have to 
endure...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"To make up for that, I want to deliver a 
great run in the Kikuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Though what will become of it remains 
an unknown quantity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown is a prestigious 
series of races. Because of that, many 
Umamusume challenge all three crowns, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Like Satono Crown, there are girls who 
perform well in the Satsuki Sho and Tokyo 
Yushun (Japanese Derby) only to skip the 
Kikuka Sho.
choice_data_list: Let's do our best with the adjustments!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dura-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hello! Summer training camp has started, 
hasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hello, Duramente-san...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Satono Diamond. A member of 
the Satono Group alongside Satono Crown, 
carrying high hopes as part of the next 
generation of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Whew... Geez, Kita-chan! You always run 
off and leave me behind!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sorry about that! Dura-san was 
there, so I just couldn't help myself!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Those two are quite alike.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh? R-Right now?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I haven't really been told that 
before, but...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Dia, the natural genius. Kitasan, the hard 
worker... They truly are different.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
However... there's a resemblance. Almost 
like... the color of blood, you could say.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, come on, Dura-san! Everyone's blood 
is red! Ahaha!"
choice_data_list: You're as energetic as ever today.

You're full of energy again today, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Being energetic is my best quality, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...I haven't really had much... to show 
for myself lately. But still!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"The final crown, the Kikuka Sho! I'll 
definitely show you I can win it!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: No. I will not yield.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ……Hm?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wasn't Duramente-san... aiming for 
the "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe"?
choice_data_list:
No, this year I'm heading for the Kikuka 
Sho.

No, this year I'm heading for the Kikuka 
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehhkk!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—Duramente-san, your next race is the 
Kikuka Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Her Derby result was great, so I totally 
thought she'd head overseas right away, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...I thought so too...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Kita-chan, are you disappointed?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...T-There's no way! Because, if that's 
true, then I..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, sorry! I think I might've left my 
bag on the bus?! I'll go check!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'll――

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to be thinking, "I'm glad 
Dura-san wasn't there"...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dura-san is going... overseas, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ahaha... So you were thinking that 
after all...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Nnnngh!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —You dummyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRAAACKK!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...No, not like this. Not while I'm this 
unfair and weak...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You want to win, don't you?! You want to 
become like Teio, don't you?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Phew!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —I have to... become stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"It's nothing. Let's start the training 
camp."
